newsitem.title: INDIA: Alliance group to enter insurance in India.
newsitem.headline: Alliance group to enter insurance in India.

text.p: Alliance Capital Asset Management Company (ACAM), the Indian subsidiary of the U.S. based fund manager, said it would enter life insurance business after India decides to open up this business to the private sector.
ACAM said on Friday it appointed S.A. Dave, advisor to the Industrial Development Bank of India and former chairman of the state-run Unit Trust of India, India's largest mutual fund, as its advisor.
Dave will join the board of ACAM and Alliance Capital's Luxumbourg-based offshore fund India Liberalisation Fund, soon.
Dave will also advise ACAM's parent company on its strategy to enter life insurance market, it said in a statement.
Alliance Capital, founded in December 1994, has launched two schemes - The Alliance 95 open-ended fund and Alliance Capital Tax Relief 96.
